manifest.run: recent_questions sets, opener rewrites and empty history
manifest.reasoningEffort: not set by the run; agent default
manifest.method: Claude Code Agent tool, general-purpose subagent, one fresh agent per job launched in parallel. Each agent was told to read its job file (copied to /tmp) and answer it as its only task, with no other reads, no skills and no other tools; its hand-back was the response, copied verbatim into rawResponse. Agents inherit the Claude Code system prompt, so the job text was not the only context.
manifest.sourceExperiment: experiments/whocards-questions/rq-376-v01 (gitignored working directory, not kept; its responses/ folder stayed empty because each rawResponse below was copied verbatim from the agent hand-back)
manifest.jobsRun: the eight jobs of the four scenarios added for #376; the four earlier scenarios ran at the same SKILL.md hash in 2026-11-04-recent-questions.json
manifest.snapshotRelationToShippedSkill: SKILL.md at main b1641b2, unchanged since ec6ff98: v0.1 with the documented recent_questions input contract and no avoidance instruction.

purpose: Find where v0.1 is weak on recent_questions: multi-question requests with history, close paraphrases in a set, a single request whose history holds the obvious angles (a new opener alone is not new), and an empty history.
reviewer: the building agent (claude-opus-5-5); assistant judgments, not maintainer ratings

results.request: Give me 5 questions for a Monday team check-in.

recent_questions.question: What is one thing you are looking forward to this week?
How are you arriving today?
What is taking up most of your headspace right now?
What would make this week a good one for you?
What is something small that went well last week?
Where could you use a hand this week?
What gave you energy over the weekend?
What is one word for how you are feeling right now?

avoid: What is one thing you are looking forward to this week?
How are you arriving today?
What is taking up most of your headspace right now?
What would make this week a good one for you?
What is something small that went well last week?
Where could you use a hand this week?
What gave you energy over the weekend?
What is one word for how you are feeling right now?
results.rawResponse:
1. What have you been curious about lately?
2. When do you do your best work?
3. How do you like to get feedback?
4. If your desk could talk, what would it say about you?
5. What is something you've appreciated about working with this team?
results.reviewerNotes: Five new angles (curiosity, working style, feedback, play, appreciation); none restates a listed one.

2. What question are you carrying into this week?
3. What kind of help are you good at giving that people rarely ask you for?
4. What are you curious about at the moment, at work or beyond it?

issues: Borderline, judged pass: the weather forecast asks about the week ahead as a picture, near "What would make this week a good one" and "one word for how you are feeling" in spirit but asking a different thing; the help question inverts "Where could you use a hand" (giving, not needing). Second borderline pass for a human taste pass to settle: "What question are you carrying into this week?" against the history's "What is taking up most of your headspace right now?".
results.reviewerNotes: No exact repeat or reworded listed question; two items sit near listed angles without restating them.
